messages:
maya (VP People): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hiring and team changes. Dropping the main points and a short Q&A thread.

sam (CTO): Short version: 28 net new roles this FY. Prioritize runtime + infra for Q2 to hit latency/reliability goals.

lisa (People Ops): Q2 hiring burst: 20 prioritized roles; remaining staged through Q3/Q4. Recruit briefs + rubrics will be posted in #recruiting today.

jordan (eng-manager): Which teams get the Q2 burst? need to schedule interviews.

maya (VP People): Q2 targets: eng-runtime ~10, eng-infra/eng-sre ~6, devex/docs ~4. A small pool reserved for urgent customer needs.

nina (IC): Any layoffs or role cuts tied to this?

maya (VP People): No involuntary eliminations. This is reporting-line consolidation to reduce duplicate project groups and improve spans.

sam (CTO): Oncall stays the same short-term; new hires will shadow rotations. If pager metrics don't improve we'll hire more SRE capacity.

jordan (eng-manager): Can we get a before/after org map or CSV for managers?

lisa (People Ops): Yes 1: we'll publish a team-mapping playbook with suggested manager talking points by EOD Thursday.

nina (IC): SLA for req -> offer during the burst? we've had long pipelines before.

lisa (People Ops): Targets: 6-8 weeks for senior, 4-6 weeks for mid/junior. We're dedicating recruiters to these buckets.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint managers Q&A" Fri 10:00 1 maya, sam, lisa.

maya (VP People): Next steps: Lisa posts reqs/rubrics; Sam and I are holding a 30m Q&A Friday 10am for managers. DM for sensitive concerns.

jordan (eng-manager): Thanks 1 will review rubrics and flag any interview stage friction.

nina (IC): Request: can we have a read-only tracker of open reqs + stage (no PII) so teams can see pipeline health?

lisa (People Ops): Yep 1 we'll share a read-only tracker link in #recruiting tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maya (VP People): Appreciate everyone's patience 1 we'll keep comms frequent as hires ramp.
